Y Pool is a stablecoin pool on the Curve Finance decentralized exchange. Y Pool runs on the Ethereum public blockchain. Y Pool is built on smart contracts. Y Pool holds yield-bearing Yearn tokens yDAI, yUSDC, yUSDT and yTUSD.

Eminence is a decentralized finance application. Eminence is built on smart contracts on a public blockchain. Eminence operates without intermediaries.
